#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Usage: render.sh TEMPLATE VALUES
# Replaces {{path.to.key}} placeholders in TEMPLATE with values from the JSON object file VALUES.

if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then
  echo "usage: render.sh TEMPLATE VALUES" >&2
  exit 2
fi

template=$1
values=$2

if [[ ! -f $template ]]; then
  echo "render.sh: no such file: $template" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -f $values ]]; then
  echo "render.sh: no such file: $values" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$values" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "render.sh: not a valid JSON object: $values" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# List each unresolved path once, in order of first appearance.
# A path is unresolved when its value is missing, null, an object or an array.
bad=$(jq -r --rawfile t "$template" --slurpfile vals "$values" '
  $vals[0] as $v
  | [$t | match("\\{\\{([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\\}\\}"; "g") | .captures[0].string] as $names
  | [$names[]
      | . as $n
      | (try ($v | getpath($n | split("."))) catch null | type) as $ty
      | select($ty == "null" or $ty == "object" or $ty == "array")
      | $n]
  | reduce .[] as $p ([]; if any(.[]; . == $p) then . else . + [$p] end)
  | .[]
' "$template" 2>/dev/null || true)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Usage: render.sh TEMPLATE VALUES
# Replaces {{path.to.key}} placeholders in TEMPLATE with values from the JSON object in VALUES.

if [[ $# -ne 2 ]]; then
  echo "usage: render.sh TEMPLATE VALUES" >&2
  exit 2
fi

template=$1
values=$2

if [[ ! -f $template ]]; then
  echo "render.sh: no such file: $template" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ ! -f $values ]]; then
  echo "render.sh: no such file: $values" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$values" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "render.sh: not a valid JSON object: $values" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# One unresolved path per line, each once, in order of first appearance.
# A path is unresolved when its value is missing, null, an object or an array.
bad=$(jq -rn --rawfile t "$template" --slurpfile vals "$values" '
  $vals[0] as $v
  | [$t | match("\\{\\{([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\\}\\}"; "g") | .captures[0].string] as $names
  | [$names[]
      | . as $n
      | (try ($v | getpath($n | split("."))) catch null | type) as $ty
      | select($ty == "null" or $ty == "object" or $ty == "array")
      | $n]
  | reduce .[] as $p ([]; if any(.[]; . == $p) then . else . + [$p] end)
  | .[]
')

if [[ -n $bad ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r path; do
    echo "render.sh: bad key $path" >&2
  done <<<"$bad"
  exit 1
fi

# -j keeps the template's final newline (or lack of one) exactly as written.
jq -jn --rawfile t "$template" --slurpfile vals "$values" '
  $vals[0] as $v
  | $t | gsub("\\{\\{(?<k>[A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\\}\\}"; (
      .k | split(".") as $p
      | $v | getpath($p)
      | if type == "string" then . else tojson end
    ))
'

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "render.sh"


def run(tmp_path, template_text, values, template_bytes=None):
    template = tmp_path / "template.txt"
    if template_bytes is not None:
        template.write_bytes(template_bytes)
    else:
        template.write_text(template_text)
    values_file = tmp_path / "values.json"
    if isinstance(values, str):
        values_file.write_text(values)
    else:
        values_file.write_text(json.dumps(values))
    return subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(SCRIPT), str(template), str(values_file)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )


def test_replaces_names_and_dotted_paths(tmp_path):
    result = run(
        tmp_path,
        "host={{db.host}} port={{port}}\n",
        {"db": {"host": "localhost"}, "port": "8080"},
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == "host=localhost port=8080\n"


def test_same_placeholder_replaced_everywhere(tmp_path):
    result = run(tmp_path, "{{a}}-{{a}}-{{b.c}}", {"a": "x", "b": {"c": "y"}})
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == "x-x-y"


def test_strings_inserted_literally(tmp_path):
    value = "a/b&c\\d $1 \\1 \\n\nline two"
    result = run(tmp_path, "[{{v}}]", {"v": value})
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == "[" + value + "]"


def test_numbers_and_booleans_inserted_as_json(tmp_path):
    result = run(
        tmp_path,
        "port={{db.port}} ssl={{db.ssl}} off={{db.off}}",
        {"db": {"port": 5432, "ssl": True, "off": False}},
    )
    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == "port=5432 ssl=true off=false"

    result = run(tmp_path, "end={{x}}", {"x": "1"})
    assert result.stdout == "end=1"

    result = run(tmp_path, "end={{x}}\n", {"x": "1"})

assert result.stdout == "end=1\n"


def test_template_without_placeholders_is_copied(tmp_path):

    assert result.returncode == 0
    assert result.stdout == "no placeholders {here}\n"

    result = run(tmp_path, "a={{a}} b={{b.c}}", {"a": "1"})
    assert result.returncode == 1
    assert result.stdout == ""
    assert result.stderr == "render.sh: bad key b.c\n"
